title: Sofia PT Data: an open archive and analysis pipeline for Sofia's public transport feeds
description:
An independent, continuously collected archive of Sofia's public transport feeds, together with a reproducible pipeline that turns raw GTFS-RT vehicle positions into per-segment speeds.

This record covers the code and the methodology. The collected data is released separately as a dataset record under CC BY 4.0.

Components

  • collect.py: continuous GTFS-RT vehicle-position collection, network bbox filtering, a per-poll heartbeat log, graceful shutdown, optional dead-man's switch.
  • scripts/archive_static_feed.py: daily GTFS static snapshots, stored only when the feed content changes.
  • scripts/generate_manifest.py: versioned SHA256 manifests over data and heartbeat files, with a poll-level breakdown of successes, empty responses and fetch errors.
  • scripts/segment_speeds.py: per-segment speeds from consecutive positions projected onto trip geometry and binned at 200 m. Segment keys are content-addressed as shape_id@<hash of geometry>, so a changed shape never merges with its predecessor.
  • scripts/export_web.py: typical-weekday median per segment and 15-minute timeslot, sliced for lazy loading, with a sample count beside every median.
  • METHODOLOGY.md: the method, published ahead of any result.

Known limitations

  • The collection bounding box was narrower than the real network until 17:04 local time on 2026-08-28. Peripheral routes were discarded before reaching disk on 27 and 28 August and cannot be recovered.
  • No static feed snapshots exist for 28-30 August 2026. The publisher serves only the current build and keeps no history.
  • The feed reports speed_ms in km/h, contrary to the GTFS-RT specification. The raw archive keeps the original field name; processed output renames it to feed_speed_kmh.
  • bearing is absent from every record.
  • The metro is not present in the GTFS-RT feed.

Source feeds: urbandata.sofia.bg, published under CC BY 4.0.
